lines.text: A circle of radius four sits in a whole-number triangle.
lines.caption: A circle of radius four sits in a whole-number triangle.

lines.text: Biggest perimeter? Most kids stop at half!
lines.caption: Biggest perimeter? Most kids stop at half!

lines.text: The circle touches A B and A C, six from A.
lines.caption: The circle touches A B and A C, six from A.

lines.text: Here's the trick. Tangent pieces from one corner are equal.
lines.caption: Here's the trick. Tangent pieces from one corner are equal.

lines.text: So each side is two pieces: six plus y, six plus z, and y plus z.
lines.caption: So each side is two pieces: six plus y, six plus z, and y plus z.

lines.text: Area two ways links y and z. If y is three, z is seventy-two!
lines.caption: Area two ways links y and z. If y is three, z is seventy-two!

lines.text: The sides: nine, seventy-five, seventy-eight. That's one hundred sixty-two!
lines.caption: The sides: nine, seventy-five, seventy-eight. That's one hundred sixty-two!

lines.text: Choice E. Eighty-one is only half of it!
